beats.vo: Audit one page by asking: can a classmate point at the finish path from the sentence alone? If they cannot, the sentence is not done. Rewrite it and ask again. On the diagram for this beat, look for a sentence and a finger-line to a path, with a second failed line faded. Do the audit once on your own page. Mark the page Example, so a later reader cannot mistake the sketch for a recommendation to trade an asset or these levels. The classmate can be you, ten minutes later. Say the opening line once more, and point at the part that belongs to Audit. If you cannot point yet, do not move on. The point of the beat is the pointing.
